verdict.rationale: uv is a traditional structured CLI (uv init, uv add, uv run, uvx, etc.) and evidence only shows discrete flag/subcommand syntax; the llms.txt reference (uv-docs-52) merely exposes docs in markdown for LLM consumption, not a natural-language command interface for operating uv itself.
